# TacoPDF - Free & Secure Online PDF Tools

TacoPDF is a client-side WebAssembly-based PDF toolkit. Your files are processed entirely offline inside your browser for maximum privacy and security. 

## Features
- Fast client-side rendering
- Secure data processing
- 100% Free to use
